keyVerseDR: "Behold the handmaid of the Lord: be it done to me according to thy word." (Lk 1:38)

level1.title: Mary Says Yes
level1.story: The angel Gabriel came to Mary. He said, "You will have a baby, the Son of God!" Mary said, "Yes! Let it be done to me."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you say yes to God?
level1.prayer: Mary, help me say yes to God. Amen.

activity.title: Hail, full of grace!
activity.intro: Fill in the missing words of the angel's greeting.
activity.text: Hail, full of [grace], the [Lord] is with thee.

level2.title: The Annunciation
level2.story: God sent the angel Gabriel to a virgin named Mary in Nazareth. The angel said, "Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with thee." Mary was troubled, but the angel said, "Fear not, Mary," for she would bear a son and call His name Jesus. Mary asked how this could be, and the angel said the Holy Spirit would come upon her. Mary said, "Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done to me according to thy word."
level2.keyLine: Be it done to me according to thy word.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why is Mary's yes so important?
Where in the Hail Mary do we hear Gabriel's words?
actions: Say yes to a hard request
level2.prayer: Hail Mary, full of grace, help me say yes. Amen.
